title: Universal Competition Assay by Nanopore Sequencing (U-CAN-Seq)
author: Jennifer Loome

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Plate Vero81 cells in six 6-well plates at 2*10^5 cells/well 24 hours prior to infection.

steps.title: Calculate Inocula
steps.instruction: Calculate inocula for each condition to have 3 ml total, targeting an inoculation volume of 400 µl/well at a total MOI = 0.01.

substeps.instruction: Prepare inocula for the following conditions: WT only, Mutant only, WT:Mutant 1:1, WT:Mutant 5:1, and WT:Mutant 10:1.
Example for 1:1 ratio: WT MOI = 0.005 and mutant MOI = 0.005.

steps.title: Infect Cells
steps.instruction: Remove media from cells and infect 5 wells of each condition by adding 400 µl of inoculum.

substeps.instruction: Return plates to the incubator and rock the plates every 15 minutes for 1 hour to ensure even distribution of infectious particles.
After 1 hour, add 3 mL of medium to each well.
Note: Only one well each of WT only, mutant only, and mock are required as controls.

steps.title: Harvest Inoculum
steps.instruction: While plates are rocking, harvest the leftover inoculum.

substeps.instruction: Move 300 µl of each inoculum to 3 tubes containing 900 µl of Trizol-LS reagent.
Freeze overnight.
Take 300 μl of supernatant from each well and place in a tube with 900 μl Trizol-LS reagent.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 10 min.
Proceed directly to RNA extraction, or freeze at -20°C (up to 1 month) or -80°C (up to a year).

steps.title: Determine Cell Count
steps.instruction: Count cells by trypsinizing 1 well in 400 µl 0.05% trypsin-EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate until cells detach, then add 600 µl of medium and resuspend.
Mix 10 µl of cell mixture with 10 µl of trypan blue.
Count with a hemocytometer using the formula: # cells/#squares counted x 2 dilution factor x 10^4 = #cells/ml = #cells/well.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction from Trizol-LS tubes containing supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 240 μl of chloroform to each tube, shake/vortex, incubate 2-3 minutes at room temperature, and spin 15 min at 12,000g at 4°C.
Move the aqueous phase to a new tube with 1 μl of glycogen or glycol-blue co-precipitant.
Add 0.6 ml isopropanol, vortex/shake to mix, and incubate overnight at -20°C (do not use -80°C).
Spin 10 min at 12,000g at 4°C to precipitate.
Remove supernatant and wash with 1.2 ml 75% ethanol, vortexing to dislodge the pellet (optional: freeze at -80°C here).
Spin again at 7500g at 4°C and remove all supernatant.
Air dry pellets until slightly translucent.
Resuspend pellet in 12 μl water by pipetting, heat at 55°C for ten minutes, return to ice, pipette to mix, and quantify via Nanodrop.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using the Superscript III kit and a gene-specific primer.

substeps.instruction: Use 8 μl of purified RNA in a reaction as per manufacturer's protocol, but extend the reaction time to 3 hours instead of 1 hour.
Mix RNA, primer, and dNTPs; heat mix to 65°C for five minutes, then return to ice for at least 1 min.
Add 10 µl mix 2/tube, heat to 50°C for 3 hours, inactivate at 85°C for 5 min, and hold at 12°C.
Proceed to PCR or freeze at -20°C.

steps.title: Amplify Genome Region via PCR
steps.instruction: Use 1 μl of each RT reaction as a template to amplify the genome region where genotypes differ.

substeps.instruction: Include a no-template control and a positive control (plasmid containing the sequence of interest).
Use the following PCR conditions (Lid: 105°C, Volume: 20 µl): 95°C for 3:00; then 34 cycles of [95°C 0:30, 56°C 0:30, 72°C 3:00]; final extension 72°C for 5:00; hold at 12°C.

steps.title: Verify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Run a gel to visualize bands.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µl of 6x loading buffer to each sample and load 4 µl of the mixture on a 1% agarose gel.
Run for 1 hr at appropriate voltage and stain with EtBr.

steps.title: Analyze Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Analyze fastq files using grep search in terminal for k-mer exact matches or matches tolerating a single mismatch.

substeps.instruction: For exact matches: Use a grep loop to search for specific k-mer strings and output counts to a .csv file.
For mismatch-tolerant analysis: Use the provided awk-based UNIX code to count both exact matches and matches with up to 1 nucleotide mismatch.
